claude.sample_unit: hospital Trust TMD patient information materials

links.outcome: Readability of UK NHS online TMD patient materials versus sixth-grade target
links.effect: Only 12/31 met target on FKGL and 1/31 on GFI/CLI; mean FRES 64.68 (6.79).
links.quote: Online patient information on TMD exceeds the recommended Year Six (sixth grade in the US) reading level.

links.outcome: Readability of AI-revised patient materials versus original, at sixth-grade target
links.effect: After Gemini revision, 96.8% met target per FKGL, 54.8% per GFI, 29.0% per CLI; mean FRES improved to 82.59 (5.73), p<0.001.
links.quote: AI chatbots, particularly Gemini, can significantly enhance the readability of these materials, enabling them to meet health literacy standards according to certain readability tools.

links.effect: 12/31 met target by FKGL; 1/31 by GFI/CLI; mean FRES 64.68 (6.79).
links.quote: Of these, 12/31 and 1/31 met the target readability according to the Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level (FKGL), and the Gunning Fog Index/Coleman-Liau Index (GFI/CLI), respectively, with mean (SD) readability at 64.68 (6.79) for Flesch Reading Ease Score (FRES).

links.effect: Gemini: 96.8% met target by FKGL, 54.8% by GFI, and 29.0% by CLI.
links.quote: After AI modification by Gemini, 96.8% met the target readability per FKGL, 54.8% per GFI, and 29.0% per CLI.

links.effect: 96.8% met target readability per FKGL, 54.8% per GFI, and 29.0% per CLI after Gemini modification
links.quote: After AI modification by Gemini, 96.8% met the target readability per FKGL, 54.8% per GFI, and 29.0% per CLI.

unlisted_practices: Using generative AI chatbots to simplify patient education materials to target reading levels
